title: From manual test case to automated test
summary: Turn the manual test case TC-LOGIN-003 into one automated test that checks every expected result. Keep the ID in the test title for traceability.
why: You already write good test cases. Automation is the same thinking: preconditions → Arrange, steps → Act, expected results → Assert. Keeping the case ID in the title links reports back to your test management tool.
objectives: Assert all three expected results (a, b, c)
pitfalls: Automating the steps but only one expected result.
One giant test that covers several test cases — keep one behaviour per test.
teachAlong: Cause: each expected result becomes an assertion.
Effect: a regression in any of a/b/c fails the test with a clear line.
Gate: checks the ID in the title and the field-value assertions.

requires.reason: Start the test title with the case ID 'TC-LOGIN-003' so reports trace back to the manual test case.
Expected result (c) is about field values — assert them with toHaveValue(...).
Expected result (b): assert the user stays on /login with toHaveURL(/\/login/).
